plot-title: The verdict of the F9 responses
plot-caption: The label of each F9 response, from the verdict spans of the extractor in text order: the last span decides; a last yes or no with the other one earlier in the text is mixed; graded is 1 middle rating; not applicable says that the photograph shows no restaurant, or that it cannot judge the spot; none is a response with no verdict span. 10,000 images for each model and case, minus the copy suspects.
